tob3_harvest-horse.name: Harvest Horse
tob3_harvest-horse.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

special_abilities.name: Beast of Burden
special_abilities.desc: Is considered one size larger for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

special_abilities.name: Construct Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Poor Traversal
special_abilities.desc: Must spend two additional feet of movement to move through difficult terrain instead of one additional foot.

special_abilities.name: Siege Monster
special_abilities.desc: Double damage to objects/structures.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: Transforms into a Large or smaller domesticated herd animal it can see such as a cow horse sheep or chicken or back into its true canine form. Its statistics other than its size are the same in each form. Reverts on death.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.desc: Takes the Disengage or Hide action.

special_abilities.name: Herd-Hidden (Herd Animal Form Only)
special_abilities.desc: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) and Cha (Deception) checks to blend into herd or convince those observing herd it is part of the herd.

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
special_abilities.desc: Has advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

special_abilities.name: One of the Herd
special_abilities.desc: A domesticated herd animal such as a cow horse sheep or chicken that can see the herd skulker treats it as a member of the herd regardless of the form skulker takes. When such an animal sees a herd skulker attack or feed it becomes immune to herd skulker’s One of the Herd for the next 24 hrs acting as it normally would when confronting a predator. Creatures immune to the charmed condition are immune to this.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.desc: Takes the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Run and Hide
reactions.desc: When a creature hinderling can see targets it with weapon hinderling chooses another creature within 5 ft. as attack's target then moves up to half its speed with o provoking opportunity attacks.

special_abilities.name: Aura of Misfortune
special_abilities.desc: Creatures within 15 ft. of it treat attack rolls of 20 as 19 and can’t gain advantage on ability checks attacks and saves.

special_abilities.name: Rejuvenation
special_abilities.desc: While hinderling curse remains on a victim a slain hinderling returns to life in 1 day regaining all its hp and becoming active again. Hinderling appears within 100' of victim.

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: Can hold its breath for 10 min.

bonus_actions.name: Protector's Step
bonus_actions.desc: Magically teleports with any items worn/carried up to 120' to unoccupied space within its sacred site or within 30' of exterior of its site. Golden light swirls or inky shadown tendrils (hippo's choice) appear at origin and destination.

special_abilities.name: Divine Awareness
special_abilities.desc: Knows if it hears a lie.

special_abilities.name: Divine Jaws
special_abilities.desc: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with Gore Gore deals extra 2d8 necrotic or radiant (included) hippo’s choice.

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: Can hold its breath for 30 min.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

special_abilities.name: Sacred Guardian
special_abilities.desc: Can pinpoint the location of an agent or worshiper of an opposing deity or a creature with ill intent toward its sacred site within 120' of itself. In addition it can sense when such a creature moves within 100' of the site and can sense general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of the site.

bonus_actions.name: Hidden Predator
bonus_actions.desc: Takes the Hide action.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: Can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Blood Scent
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on Wis (Perception) and Wis (Survival) checks to find or track a creature that doesn’t have all its hp.

tob3_howler-of-the-hill.name: Howler Of The Hill
tob3_howler-of-the-hill.languages: understands Abyssal, Common, Infernal, and Void Speech but can't speak, telepathy 120'

special_abilities.name: Hungry Void Traveler
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t require air drink or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Inscrutable
special_abilities.desc: Immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts and any divination spell it refuses. Wis (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions/sincerity have disadvantage.

tob3_hvalfiskr.name: Hvalfiskr
tob3_hvalfiskr.senses: darkvision 12017 ft., blindsight 120 ft., passive Perception 17

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: Transforms into Huge frost giant Huge whale or back into its true whale-giant hybrid form. Its stats are the same in each form. Items worn/carried transform with it. Reverts on death.

bonus_actions.name: Reel Anchor
bonus_actions.desc: Pulls on the chain connected to anchor returning it to its empty hand. If anchor is hooked around a creature creature: DC 19 Str save or be pulled up to 30' toward hvalfiskr.

special_abilities.name: Echolocation (Whale Form Only)
special_abilities.desc: No blindsight while deafened.

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: Can hold its breath for 1 hr.

special_abilities.name: Speak with Cetaceans
special_abilities.desc: Can communicate with dolphins porpoises and whales as if they shared a language.

special_abilities.name: Fiery Blood
special_abilities.desc: When it takes damage each creature within 5 ft. of it: DC 15 Dex save or take 3 (1d6) fire. The fire ignites flammable objects within 5 ft. of ibexian that aren’t being worn or carried.

special_abilities.name: Fiery Charge
special_abilities.desc: If it moves 20'+ straight toward a target and then hits it with Ram attack on the same turn target takes extra 7 (2d6) fire. If target is a creature it must make DC 15 Str save or be pushed up to 10 ft. away and knocked prone.

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on attacks vs. creature if 1+ unincapacitated attacker ally is within 5 ft. of target.

special_abilities.name: Fear of Fire
special_abilities.desc: An ice urchin is inherently fearful of fire. If presented forcefully with fire or if it is dealt fire the ice urchin must make DC 13 Wis save or become frightened until the end of its next turn. Once it has been frightened by a specific source of fire (such as a torch) the ice urchin can’t be frightened by that same source again for 24 hrs.

special_abilities.name: Ice Slide
special_abilities.desc: Its speed increases to 60' when it moves on snow or ice. Additionally difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn’t cost it extra movement.

special_abilities.name: Melting Away
special_abilities.desc: If it takes fire damage its AC is reduced by 2 and it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Spiny Defense
special_abilities.desc: A creature that touches the ice urchin or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 3 (1d6) piercing damage and 2 (1d4) cold.

special_abilities.name: Venomous Spine Regrowth
special_abilities.desc: An ice urchin has twelve venomous spines. Used spines regrow when the ice urchin finishes a long rest.

reactions.name: Melting Icicles
reactions.desc: When the ice willow takes fire it can immediately use Icicle Drop if available.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While motionless indistinguishable from ice-covered willow tree.

special_abilities.name: Ice Melt
special_abilities.desc: If it takes fire damage its icicles partially melt. Until the end of the ice willow’s next turn creatures have advantage on saves vs. the willow’s Icicle Drop and Icicle Spray.

tob3_iceworm.name: Iceworm
tob3_iceworm.senses: blindsight 90 ft., tremorsense 30 ft., passive Perception 11

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: Can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Cold Physiology
special_abilities.desc: Can’t abide constant warmth. Each hr it spends in an area with temperature above 40 degrees Fahrenheit worm must make DC 15 Con save or suffer one level of exhaustion that can’t be removed until it finishes a long rest in area with temperature below 40 degrees.

special_abilities.name: Heat Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: Has disadvantage on attack rolls when within 5 ft. of a strong source of heat that isn’t a warm-blooded creature’s natural warmth such as a torch or campfire. In addition the iceworm can pinpoint the location of warm-blooded creatures within 90' of it and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of it.

special_abilities.name: Slippery
special_abilities.desc: Has advantage on saves and ability checks made to escape a grapple.

reactions.name: Muster the Legions
reactions.desc:
1/día.
When the imperator is reduced to half its hp or lower it magically calls 1d4 swarms of penguins. The penguins arrive on initiative count 20 of the next round acting as allies of the imperator and obeying its telepathic commands. The penguins remain for 1 hr until the imperator dies or until the imperator dismisses them as a bonus action.

special_abilities.name: Essential Oiliness
special_abilities.desc: Has advantage on saves and ability checks made to escape a grapple or end restrained condition.

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: Can hold its breath for 1 hr.

special_abilities.name: Pelagic Bile (Recharge 6)
special_abilities.desc: The imperator regurgitates its stomach contents in a 60' cone. All in area make a DC 17 Dex save. On a failure a creature takes 17 (5d6) acid and 17 (5d6) poison and is poisoned for 1 min. On a success a creature takes half the damage and isn’t poisoned. A poisoned creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself. Swallowed creatures are then regurgitated falling prone in a space within 10 ft. of the imperator.

special_abilities.name: Penguin Telepathy
special_abilities.desc: Can magically command any penguin within 120' of it using a limited telepathy.

special_abilities.name: Siege Monster
special_abilities.desc: Double damage to objects/structures.

special_abilities.name: Toboggan Charge (Recharge 5–6)
special_abilities.desc: The imperator moves up to 30' in a straight line over ice or snow and can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. The first time it enters a creature’s space during this move that creature must make a DC 17 Str save. On a failure a creature takes 36 (8d8) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success a creature takes half the damage and isn’t knocked prone.

special_abilities.name: Wing Slap
special_abilities.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 16 (2d10+5) bludgeoning damage.

tob3_imperator-penguin-swarm.name: Imperator, Penguin Swarm
tob3_imperator-penguin-swarm.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

special_abilities.name: Swarm
special_abilities.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature’s space and vice-versa and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Med penguin. The swarm can’t regain hp or gain temp hp.

special_abilities.name: Tobogganing Tide
special_abilities.desc: The swarm can move at double its walking speed over ice and snow.

tob3_incandescent-one.name: Incandescent One
tob3_incandescent-one.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, poisoned, prone, restrained

bonus_actions.name: Celestial Inspiration
bonus_actions.desc: Inspires one creature it can see within 60' of it. Whenever target makes attack roll or save before start of incandescent one's next turn target can roll a d4 and add number rolled to the attack roll or save.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: Can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Aqueous Form
special_abilities.desc: Can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide with o squeezing.

special_abilities.name: Flyby
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

special_abilities.name: Immortal Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn't require food drink or sleep

special_abilities.name: Luminous
special_abilities.desc: Sheds dim light in a 5 ft. radius.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: Weapon attacks are magical.

tob3_ion-slime.name: Ion Slime
tob3_ion-slime.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

bonus_actions.name: Charged Motion
bonus_actions.desc: Dash or Dodge action.

bonus_actions.name: Supercharge
bonus_actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
Gathers ambient electricity to supercharge itself for 3 rounds. While supercharged slime gains +2 bonus to its AC and it gains an additional action on each of its turns. At end of the third round if the slime hasn't used the Discharge action it suffers feedback taking 18 (4d8) force. Its supercharged state then ends.

special_abilities.name: Amorphous
special_abilities.desc: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

special_abilities.name: Ionic Form
special_abilities.desc: Whenever subjected to lightning it takes no damage and instead regains hp equal to lightning dealt. Its Supercharge then recharges. If it takes cold while supercharged it must roll a d6. On a 1 or 2 it loses the supercharged state.

special_abilities.name: Ooze Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t require sleep.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: Difficult surfaces even ceilings no ability check.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: + 2 to its AC vs. one melee attack that would hit it if it can see attacker and wielding melee weapon.

special_abilities.name: Elemental Weapons
special_abilities.desc: Its weapon attacks are imbued with its elemental power. When the jinnborn hits with any weapon the weapon deals an extra 1d6 lightning (included in the attack).

special_abilities.name: Flamboyant Defense
special_abilities.desc: While it is wearing no armor and wielding no shield its AC includes its Cha modifier.

special_abilities.name: Knows the Ropes
special_abilities.desc: Has proficiency with airships sandships or waterborne ships (the jinnborn’s choice). It adds its proficiency bonus to any check it makes to control the chosen type of ship and it adds its proficiency bonus to any saves made while on the chosen type of vehicle.

reactions.name: Impassioned Riposte
reactions.desc: When a creature the jubjub bird can see misses it with an attack while within 10 ft. of it the jubjub bird can make one Bite attack vs. the attacker.

special_abilities.name: Shrill Screech
special_abilities.desc: When agitated the jubjub bird makes a near constant shrill and high scream giving it advantage on Cha (Intimidation) checks.

special_abilities.name: Stubborn
special_abilities.desc: Has advantage on saves vs. being charmed. In addition Wis (Animal Handling) checks are made with disadvantage vs. the jubjub bird.

special_abilities.name: Unpredictable
special_abilities.desc: Opportunity attacks vs. the jubjub bird are made with disadvantage.

bonus_actions.name: Hop Away
bonus_actions.desc: Takes the Dash or Disengage action.

special_abilities.name: Aura of Honesty
special_abilities.desc: Creature that enters space within 10 ft. of sheriff for 1st time on a turn or starts turn there: DC 13 Cha save or be unable to speak deliberate lie until it starts its turn more than 10 ft. away from sheriff. Creatures affected by this are aware of it and sheriff knows whether creature in area succeeded/failed save.

special_abilities.name: Sheriff’s Duty
special_abilities.desc: Knows if it hears a lie and can’t speak deliberate lie.

special_abilities.name: Unfailing Memory
special_abilities.desc: Remembers every creature that has ever spoken to it. If creature has spoken to sheriff and speaks to sheriff again while polymorphed or disguised sheriff has advantage on Int (Investigation) Wis (Insight) and Wis (Perception) checks to identify or recognize that creature.

special_abilities.name: Impaling Charge
special_abilities.desc: If it moves 20+' straight toward a target and then hits it with Horn attack on same turn karkadann impales target on its horn grappling the target if it is a Large or smaller creature (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends the target is restrained takes 18 (4d8) piercing damage at start of each of its turns and karkadann can’t make horn attacks vs. other targets.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

tob3_khamaseen.name: Khamaseen
tob3_khamaseen.condition_immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

reactions.name: Shock
reactions.desc: If a creature wearing metal armor or wielding a metal weapon or shield moves within 5 ft. of khamaseen it takes 5 (2d4) lightning (DC 12 Dex negates).

special_abilities.name: Elemental Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Stinging Dust
special_abilities.desc: Is surrounded by a cloud of swirling dust and small stones. A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the khamaseen must make DC 12 Con save or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn. On a successful save the creature is immune to the khamaseen’s Stinging Dust for the next 24 hrs.

tob3_khargi.name: Khargi
tob3_khargi.languages: understands Abyssal and Infernal but can't speak
tob3_khargi.senses: darkvision 60 ft., blindsight 30 ft., passive Perception 12

reactions.name: Adaptive Carapace
reactions.desc: When it takes acid cold force lightning or thunder it can magically attune itself to that type of damage. Until end of its next turn khargi has resistance to damage of the triggering type and when it hits with any weapon target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage of the triggering type.

special_abilities.name: Deadly Infestation
special_abilities.desc: A creature that touches the khargi or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 7 (2d6) poison as stinging insects rise up to protect the khargi.

special_abilities.name: Death Swarms
special_abilities.desc: When it dies the insects crawling across and within it burst from its body forming 2d4 swarms of insects that appear in unoccupied spaces within 5 ft. of khargi’s space.

special_abilities.name: Infested Weapons
special_abilities.desc: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon deals + 2d6 poison (included below).

reactions.name: Failsafe Equipment
reactions.desc: The drake rider wears wing-like arm and feet flaps folded on its back. If its mount dies or it is dismounted the rider descends 60' per round and takes no damage from falling if its mount was flying or it gains a swimming speed of 30' for 1 min if its mount was swimming.

special_abilities.name: Drake Mount
special_abilities.desc: Has formed a bond with Med or larger drake mount (found in this or other books or use the statistics of a giant lizard). Regardless of the drake’s intelligence it acts as a controlled mount while carrying a drake rider obeying the rider’s spoken commands. Mounting and dismounting the drake costs the drake rider only 5 ft. of movement.

special_abilities.name: Mounted Warrior
special_abilities.desc: While the drake rider is mounted its mount can’t be charmed or frightened.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

special_abilities.name: Sure Seat
special_abilities.desc: While mounted and not incapacitated the drake rider can’t be knocked prone dismounted or moved vs. its will.

special_abilities.name: Trained Tactics (Recharge 4–6)
special_abilities.desc: The drake rider commands its mount to move up to 30' in a straight line moving through the space of any Large or smaller creature and performing one of the following tactical maneuvers. This movement doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks.Barrel Roll: The mount flies up and over one creature in the line ending its movement at least 10 ft. past the target. As the drake rider hangs upside down at the top of the loop it makes one Spear attack vs. the target with advantage. On a hit the rider rolls damage dice three times. The mount must have a flying speed to use this maneuver.Corkscrew Roll: The mount swims in a corkscrew around the creatures in the line. Each creature in the line must make DC 13 Dex save or be incapacitated with dizziness until the end of its next turn. The mount must have a swimming speed to use this maneuver.Weaving Rush The mount weaves back and forth along the line. Each creature in the line must make DC 13 Str save or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

tob3_kobold-empyrean.name: Kobold, Empyrean
tob3_kobold-empyrean.damage_resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison; nonmagic B/P/S attacks

reactions.name: Draconic Ascension
reactions.desc: When a kobold it can see is reduced to 0 hp empyrean can reincarnate the kobold as a wyrmling dragon of a type befitting that kobold and its virtues. Empyrean can provide ascension to up to two kobolds each hr with this reaction.

special_abilities.name: Aura of Draconic Virtue
special_abilities.desc: Kobolds within 30' of an empyrean kobold have advantage on attack rolls and ability checks. At the start of each of its turns empyrean kobold can choose to exclude any number of kobolds from this aura (no action required).

special_abilities.name: Elemental Weapons
special_abilities.desc: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon weapon deal extra 3d8 acid cold fire lightning or poison (included below) kobold’s choice.

special_abilities.name: Immortal Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn't require food drink or sleep

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

bonus_actions.name: Grappling Hook
bonus_actions.desc:
Recarga: 4.
The ghost hunter launches its grappling hook at a Large or larger object or structure or at a Huge or larger creature it can see within 60' of it and is pulled to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the target with o provoking opportunity attacks.

bonus_actions.name: Elusive Hunter
bonus_actions.desc: Takes the Dodge or Hide action.

reactions.name: Flame Burst
reactions.desc: When a hostile creature enters a space within 5 ft. of the ghost hunter the hunter can release a burst of fire from its clockwork hand. The creature must make DC 17 Dex save or take 7 (2d6) fire and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes vs. the ghost hunter before the end of the ghost hunter's next turn.

special_abilities.name: Blessed Weapons
special_abilities.desc: Its weapon attacks are magical. When the hunter hits with any weapon the weapon deals an extra 3d8 radiant (included in the attack).

special_abilities.name: Ethereal Sight
special_abilities.desc: Can see 60' into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane and vice versa.

special_abilities.name: Flame Jet
special_abilities.desc: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit 5 ft. or range 60' one target 18 (4d6+4) fire. If the target is a creature or a flammable object that isn’t being worn or carried it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire the target takes 5 (1d10) fire at the start of each of its turns.

special_abilities.name: Hand Crossbow
special_abilities.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit 30/120' one target 9 (1d6+6) piercing damage + 13 (3d8) radiant.

special_abilities.name: Hidden Hunter
special_abilities.desc: While the ghost hunter remains motionless it is invisible to Undead.

special_abilities.name: Holy Strike (Recharge 5–6)
special_abilities.desc: The ghost hunter flips up its eyepatch to reveal a holy relic embedded within the empty socket. Each creature within 30' of the ghost hunter must make a DC 17 Dex save taking 36 (8d8) radiant on a failed save or half damage if made. If an Undead fails the save it is also stunned until the end of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on attacks vs. creature if 1+ unincapacitated attacker ally is within 5 ft. of target.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

special_abilities.name: Undead Hunter
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on Wis (Perception) and Wis (Survival) checks to find and track Undead.

bonus_actions.name: Recall Harpoon
bonus_actions.desc: Pulls on the cord connected to its harpoon returning harpoon to its empty hand. If harpoon is stuck in a creature that creature must make DC 17 Str save or be pulled up to 20' toward the hunter.

reactions.name: Grappled Redirect
reactions.desc: If it is target of an attack it can see while grappling a creature it can hold the grappled creature in the way and the grappled creature becomes attack's target instead.

special_abilities.name: Expert Wrestler
special_abilities.desc: Can grapple creatures that are two sizes larger than itself and can move at its full speed when dragging a creature it has grappled. If hunter grapples a Med or smaller creature target has disadvantage on its escape attempts. Hunter has advantage on ability checks and saves made to escape a grapple or end the restrained condition.

special_abilities.name: Hardy Defense
special_abilities.desc: While hunter is wearing no armor and wielding no shield its AC includes its Con modifier.

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: Can hold its breath for 30 min.

special_abilities.name: Leviathan Hunter
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on Wis (Perception) and Wis (Survival) checks to find and track Large or larger creatures with swimming speed.

special_abilities.name: Marine Weapons
special_abilities.desc: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon weapon deals an extra 2d8 cold or poison (included below) hunter’s choice.

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on attacks vs. creature if 1+ unincapacitated attacker ally is within 5 ft. of target.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

bonus_actions.name: Planar Step
bonus_actions.desc: Teleports along with any equipment up to 30' to an unoccupied spot it sees. Glowing swirls of elemental energy appear at origin and destination when it uses this.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: + 4 to its AC vs. one melee attack that would hit it if it can see attacker and wielding melee weapon.

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on attacks vs. creature if 1+ unincapacitated attacker ally is within 5 ft. of target.

special_abilities.name: Planar Attunement
special_abilities.desc: At the start of each of its turns it chooses one of the following damage types: acid cold fire lightning necrotic radiant or thunder. It has resistance to the chosen damage type until start of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Planar Weapons
special_abilities.desc: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon weapon deals extra 3d8 damage of the type chosen with Planar Attunement (included below).

special_abilities.name: Planes Hunter
special_abilities.desc: Has advantage on Wis (Perception) and Wis (Survival) checks to find and track Celestials Fiends and Elementals.

special_abilities.name: Snaring Blade
special_abilities.desc: If it scores a critical hit vs. a creature target can’t use any method of extradimensional movement including teleportation or travel to a different plane of existence for 1 min. The creature can make a DC 16 Cha save at the end of each of its turns ending effect on itself on a success.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

special_abilities.name: Crafty
special_abilities.desc: The sapper has advantage on ability checks made to pick locks or to detect disarm or set traps.

special_abilities.name: Evasion
special_abilities.desc: If subject to effect that allows Dex save for half damage takes no damage on success and only half if it fails.

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on attacks vs. creature if 1+ unincapacitated attacker ally is within 5 ft. of target.

special_abilities.name: Siege Monster
special_abilities.desc: Double damage to objects/structures.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

special_abilities.name: Toxic Ichor
special_abilities.desc: While submerged in water it’s ichor taints water within 10 ft. of it. When a creature enters area for the 1st time on a turn or starts its turn there that creature must make DC 15 Con save or be poisoned while it remains in area and for 1 min after it leaves. A poisoned creature that is no longer in the water can re-save at end of each of its turns ending effect on itself on a success. If purify food and drink spell is cast on a space within 5 ft. of lotus or on space it occupies trait ceases to function for 1 min.

special_abilities.name: Undead Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Waterwalker
special_abilities.desc: Can walk across surface of water as if it were solid ground. Otherwise works like water walk but isn’t itself magical.

tob3_leashed-lesion.name: Leashed Lesion
tob3_leashed-lesion.languages: understands Void Speech but can't speak

bonus_actions.name: Life Tether
bonus_actions.desc: Attaches a symbiotic tether to a creature sitting in the recess in its back. A creature in the recess that isn't attached to the tether takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage at the end of the lesion's turn and the lesion regains hp equal to the damage dealt. While the tether is attached the creature is grappled by the lesion. The lesion or the creature can detach the tether as a bonus action. Lesion can have its symbiotic tether attached to only one creature at a time.

bonus_actions.name: Drain Magic Item
bonus_actions.desc: Drains the magic from an item it is holding. Magic item with charges loses 1d6 charges item with limited uses per day loses one daily use and single-use item such as potion or spell scroll is destroyed. All other magic items have their effects suppressed for 1 min. Wanderer gains 5 temp hp each time it drains a magic item. A drained item regains its magic after 24 hrs.

reactions.name: Absorb Spell
reactions.desc: When a creature wanderer can see within 30' of it casts spell wanderer can absorb spell's energy countering it. Works like counterspell except wanderer must always make spellcasting ability check no matter spell's level. Its ability check for this is +7. If it successfully counters the spell it gains 5 temp hp/spell level.

special_abilities.name: Sense Magic
special_abilities.desc: Senses magic within 120' of it at will. This otherwise works like the detect magic spell but isn’t itself magical.

tob3_life-broker.name: Life Broker
tob3_life-broker.damage_resistances: nonmagic B/P/S attacks not made w/cold iron weapons

bonus_actions.name: Quick-Footed
bonus_actions.desc: Takes Dash Disengage or Dodge.

special_abilities.name: Draw Life Essence
special_abilities.desc: Can spend 10 min coaxing life essence out of willing creature taking only agreed amount of time from creature’s max lifetime. Essence appears as rosy mist that rises from mouth nose or skin of creature and snakes into carved crystal vial in broker’s cloak where it takes the form of a crimson liquid. Creature that drinks such a vial gains life stored within it provided broker gave vial willingly. If broker draws all remaining life from creature creature dies and can be returned to life only via wish spell.

special_abilities.name: Life Reading
special_abilities.desc: If it spends 1 min studying a mortal creature it can see within 30' of it broker can determine the remainder of that creature’s natural life to the second.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

special_abilities.name: Necrotic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon weapon deals + 4d8 necrotic (included below).

reactions.name: Emergency Flare
reactions.desc: When it takes damage can emit brilliant flash of light. Each creature within 30': blinded 1 min (DC 12 Con negates). Blinded creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While motionless indistinguishable from normal rock.

special_abilities.name: Light Absorption
special_abilities.desc: When it starts its turn within 5 ft. of a source of light light is reduced while eater remains within 100' of light source. Bright light becomes dim and dim becomes darkness. If eater reduces light source’s light to darkness eater sheds multicolored bright light in 20' radius and dim light for additional 20' for 1 hr and light source is extinguished if it is nonmagical flame or dispelled if it was created by 2nd level or lower spell.

special_abilities.name: Light Sense
special_abilities.desc: Can pinpoint location of any light source within 100' of it and sense general direction of any within 1 mile.

tob3_living-soot.name: Living Soot
tob3_living-soot.condition_immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

special_abilities.name: Brittle
special_abilities.desc: If it takes cold it partially freezes; its speed is reduced by 10 ft. and its AC is reduced by 2 until end of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Choking Air Form
special_abilities.desc: Can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there and it can move through a space as narrow as 1ft. wide with o squeezing. In addition when creature starts turn in same space as soot creature: 7 (2d6) poison and be unable to breathe until it starts its turn outside soot’s space (DC 15 Con negates).

special_abilities.name: Elemental Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While motionless indistinguishable from tangled mass of blackened dusty webbing.

special_abilities.name: Danger From Above
special_abilities.desc: If it jumps 10 ft.+ straight toward a creature from a higher position than the target such as leaping down from a tree it has advantage on next attack roll it makes vs. that creature.

special_abilities.name: Standing Leap
special_abilities.desc: Its long jump is up to 30' and its high jump is up to 15 ft. with or with o a running start.

special_abilities.name: Swamp Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

tob3_lycanthrope-werecrocodile.name: Lycanthrope, Werecrocodile
tob3_lycanthrope-werecrocodile.damage_immunities: nonmagic bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing attacks not made with silvered weapons

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: Transforms into a Large crocodile or into a crocodile-humanoid hybrid or back into its true form which is Humanoid. Its stats other than size are the same in each form. Any equipment worn/carried isn't transformed. Reverts to its true form if it dies.

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath (Crocodile or Hybrid Form Only)
special_abilities.desc: Can hold its breath for 15 min.

tob3_lycanthrope-wereotter.name: Lycanthrope, Wereotter
tob3_lycanthrope-wereotter.damage_immunities: nonmagic bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing attacks not made with silvered weapons

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: Transforms into a Med otter-humanoid hybrid or into Large otter or back into true form: Humanoid. Stats other than size are same in each form. Items worn/ carried not transformed. Reverts to its true form if it dies.

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: Can hold its breath for 10 min.

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

bonus_actions.name: Metal Eater
bonus_actions.desc: Swallows one Med or smaller ferrous metal object within 5 ft. of it. If the object is being held or worn by a creature that creature must make DC 18 Str save or malmbjorn swallows the object. If the creature holding or wearing the object is also grappled by the malmbjorn it has disadvantage on this save. Nonmagical objects are digested and destroyed at the start of malmbjorn's next turn. Magic objects remain intact in malmbjorn's stomach for 8 hrs then are destroyed. Artifacts are never destroyed in this way.

reactions.name: Ironhide
reactions.desc: When hit by a metal weapon fur-like metal spikes grow out of its hide until end of its next turn. While spikes remain its AC increases 2 and any critical hit vs. it becomes a normal hit.

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: smell Wis (Percept) checks.

special_abilities.name: Metal Sense
special_abilities.desc: Can pinpoint by scent location of any Small or larger ferrous metal such as an iron deposit or steel armor within 100' of it. It can sense general direction of such metal within 1 mile.

special_abilities.name: Tunneler
special_abilities.desc: Can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 15-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

special_abilities.name: Keen Sight
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: sight Wis (Percept) checks.

special_abilities.name: Snake Hunter
special_abilities.desc: Has advantage on saves vs. being poisoned.

tob3_meerkats-swarm.name: Meerkats, Swarm
tob3_meerkats-swarm.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

special_abilities.name: Corral
special_abilities.desc: A creature in the swarm’s space must make DC 12 Dex save to leave its space. The creature has advantage on its save if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer.

special_abilities.name: Keen Sight
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: sight Wis (Percept) checks.

special_abilities.name: Snake Hunter
special_abilities.desc: Has advantage on saves vs. being poisoned.

special_abilities.name: Swarm
special_abilities.desc: Can occupy another creature's space and vice versa and swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny meerkat. Swarm can't regain hp or gain temp hp.

special_abilities.name: Grassland Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks made to hide in grassland terrain.

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: smell Wis (Percept) checks.

special_abilities.name: Pounce
special_abilities.desc: If the megantereon moves at least 20' straight toward a creature and then hits with Claw attack on the same turn that target must make DC 14 Str save or be knocked prone. If the target is prone the megantereon can make one Bite attack vs. it as a bonus action.

special_abilities.name: Running Leap
special_abilities.desc: With a 10 ft. running start the megantereon can long jump up to 20'.

tob3_midnight-sun.name: Midnight Sun
tob3_midnight-sun.damage_vulnerabilities: necrotic (in day form), radiant (in night form)
tob3_midnight-sun.damage_resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; nonmagic B/P/S attacks
tob3_midnight-sun.damage_immunities: necrotic (in night form), poison, radiant (in day form)
tob3_midnight-sun.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

special_abilities.name: Changing Form
special_abilities.desc: Automatically changes based on presence light.Day Form. While more than half midnight sun is in darkness it appears as a glowing orb of light but sheds no light. In this form it deals radiant has immunity to radiant and vulnerability to necrotic.Night Form. While more than half the midnight sun is in bright or dim light it appears as an orb of darkness. In this form it deals necrotic has immunity to necrotic and has vulnerability to radiant.Twilight Form. While half of it is in bright or dim light and half is in darkness it appears as split orb of light and darkness. It deals force.

special_abilities.name: Energy Being
special_abilities.desc: Can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide with o squeezing and it can enter a hostile creature’s space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature’s space on a turn that creature takes 3 (1d6) damage of the type determined by the sun’s current form.

special_abilities.name: Reality Inversion
special_abilities.desc: When creature starts turn in sun’s space or within 5 ft. any circumstance trait or feature that would grant it advantage instead grants disadvantage and vice versa until start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Enthralling Defense
reactions.desc: When a creature the mindshard can see within 30' of it hits it with an attack that creature must make DC 14 Cha save or be charmed until end of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Mindleech Aura
special_abilities.desc: When a charmed creature enters a space within 15 ft. of the mindshard on a turn or starts its turn within 15 ft. of the mindshard that creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic.

special_abilities.name: Translucent
special_abilities.desc: Is invisible to creatures more than 60' away from it.

special_abilities.name: Charge
special_abilities.desc: If it moves 10 ft.+ straight to foe and hits with gore attack on same turn target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature it must make DC 14 Str save or be pushed up to 10 ft. away and knocked prone.

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: smell Wis (Percept) checks.

special_abilities.name: Labyrinthine Recall
special_abilities.desc: Can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.

special_abilities.name: Ravening Hunger
special_abilities.desc: When it reduces a creature to 0 hp with melee attack on its turn can take a bonus action to consume creature’s heart. Its hp max increases by 5 for every ten hearts it consumes in this way.

special_abilities.name: Ravening Madness
special_abilities.desc: Disadvantage on Int checks and saves. Considers every creature hostile and doesn’t benefit from Help action or similar spells/effects that involve help to/from friendly creatures. Doesn’t stop spellcaster from restoring hp to it or curing ravening with magic.

special_abilities.name: Reckless
special_abilities.desc: At the start of its turn it can choose to have advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn but attack rolls vs. it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While motionless indistinguishable from normal vine.

bonus_actions.name: Emboldening Song
bonus_actions.desc:
2/día.
Delivers a burst of beautiful song that motivates and emboldens one friendly creature the moon weaver can see within 60' of it. If the target can hear the song it gains one Embolden die a d6. Once within the next 10 min the target can roll the die and add the number rolled to one ability check attack roll or save it makes.

special_abilities.name: Lubricious Plumage
special_abilities.desc: Its skin exudes an oil that permeates its plumage. The moon weaver can’t be restrained by magical or nonmagical webbing and it ignores all movement restrictions caused by webbing.

tob3_moonless-hunter.name: Moonless Hunter
tob3_moonless-hunter.damage_resistances: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing or slashing from nonmagical attacks not made w/silvered weapons

special_abilities.name: Deathly Origins
special_abilities.desc: Can be turned and damaged by holy water as Undead.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

special_abilities.name: Nightmare Leap
special_abilities.desc: Once on its turn can use half its move to step magically into dreams of sleeping creature within 5 ft. of it. Emerges from dreams of another sleeper within 1 mile of 1st appearing in unoccupied space within 5 ft. of 2nd. Each sleeper suffers a level of exhaustion as nightmares prevent restful sleep (DC 14 Wis negates). Creature that fails save by 5+ also suffers long-term madness.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: Difficult surfaces even ceilings no ability check.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

tob3_moonweb.name: Moonweb
tob3_moonweb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, prone

bonus_actions.name: Ethereal Jaunt
bonus_actions.desc: Magically shifts from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane or vice versa.

special_abilities.name: Alien Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t require air or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Transparent
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks while motionless or in dim light.

tob3_moppet.name: Moppet
tob3_moppet.languages: understands one language known by its creator but can't speak
tob3_moppet.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, incapacitated, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, stunned, unconscious

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Moves
bonus_actions.desc: Takes the Dash or Disengage action.

special_abilities.name: Construct Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: Motionless: indistinguishable from normal doll.

special_abilities.name: Psychic Pool
special_abilities.desc: Absorbs psychic energy from creatures in its nightmare holding up to four Psychic Points. As a bonus action while casting a spell within 5 ft. of moppet owner can expend points equal to spell’s level to cast with o using spell slot.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: Can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While motionless indistinguishable from bed of lotus flowers.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

special_abilities.name: Poisonous Tendrils
special_abilities.desc: A creature that starts its turn grappled by the mortifera must make DC 15 Con save or be poisoned for 1 min. A poisoned creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.
